$comment: Qwen Runner backlog. Dependency-ordered, chunked small enough for a 27B local model. Each task: specs[] (the contract, auto-inlined), context[] (high-confidence exemplars, auto-inlined), deps[] (run after these reach review/done), reason (enable Qwen thinking), mayTouchShipped (allowed to edit shipped code, always flag), checks (override default gate). AGENTS.md, the spec template, and the data model are auto-added to every task. Re-run `node qwen-runner/run.mjs --seed` after editing.

tasks.title: Full product detail page /products/[slug]
tasks.goal: Replace the /products/[slug] skeleton with the full product detail page per product.md: hero, pricing/license tiers, description (WYSIWYG render), file/curriculum summary, add-to-cart, related products. RSC + ISR, p95<200ms, design tokens only. Reviews/curriculum preview that the spec defers to PH16 stay deferred (note in STUBS.md).

tasks.title: GDPR data export (Art.15) + account deletion (Art.17)
tasks.goal: Finish the account area: a 'Download my data' JSON export (Art.15) and the account-delete flow (Art.17) that calls the delete_my_account RPC (migration 0010) with typed confirmation, blocking when active subscriptions / pending payouts exist (STUB-019). Follow account-settings.md.

tasks.title: Avatar upload (Bunny signed PUT + cropper) — resolves STUB-017
tasks.goal: Wire avatar upload on /account/profile: Bunny signed PUT URL, mime allowlist (jpeg/png/webp), 5MB cap, square crop, storage path avatars/{user_id}/{uuid}.{ext}. Remove STUB-017 from STUBS.md when done.

tasks.title: /partner/courses/[id] — 5-tab course detail
tasks.goal: Build the per-product management page with 5 tabs (Curriculum, Pricing, Sales, Reviews, Settings) per partner-courses-detail.md. Partner-scoped RLS; partner sees only their own product. Use the existing PartnerShell + StatusBadge.

tasks.title: Instructor upload backend — Bunny tus + ClamAV scan + status
tasks.goal: Foundation/platform for instructor uploads: Bunny tus resumable upload session minting, a webhook handler that updates product_files.scan_status (ClamAV) and encoding_status, and enforcement that files only serve when scan_status='clean' AND encoding_status='ready'. No UI here — just the seams + webhook + queries. Follow instructor-upload.md (backend half).

tasks.title: Instructor upload UI — multi-step upload page
tasks.goal: Build the multi-step /partner/instructor-upload page consuming the upload backend: draft persistence, tus upload widget with progress, scan/encode status display, publish gate. Follow instructor-upload.md (UI half).

tasks.title: /partner/sales analytics + per-product aggregates (STUB-032/035)
tasks.goal: Partner sales analytics page: lifetime + period sales, units, per-product revenue aggregates against order_items + payout_ledger. Resolve STUB-032 (dashboard lifetime sales) and STUB-035 (per-product aggregates). Follow partner-courses-sales.md.

tasks.title: /partner/onboarding wizard (+welcome/thanks)
tasks.goal: Multi-step partner onboarding wizard with draft persistence, plus welcome and thanks pages. Follow partner-onboarding*.md.

tasks.title: /partner/settings payout method + API tokens
tasks.goal: Partner payout-method management and API-token settings. Follow partner-settings-payout.md and partner-settings-api.md.

tasks.title: Affiliate portal shell + dashboard
tasks.goal: Create the affiliate feature module + shell (mirror the PartnerShell pattern) and the affiliate dashboard (clicks, conversions, earnings KPIs). Follow affiliate-dashboard.md.

tasks.title: Affiliate onboarding (+welcome/thanks)
tasks.goal: Affiliate onboarding wizard + welcome + thanks. Follow affiliate-onboarding*.md.

tasks.title: Affiliate links generator

tasks.goal: Affiliate settings: profile, payout method, API tokens. Follow affiliate-settings*.md.

tasks.goal: Public affiliate mini-shop at /[handle] + the shop surface, with attribution to the affiliate. Follow affiliate-minishop.md and affiliate-shop.md. Public route (no auth) — confirm in spec.

tasks.goal: Admin customers list (filters, risk) + customer detail. EVERY read of customer PII writes an admin_audit_log row. Follow admin-customers.md + admin-customer-detail.md.

tasks.title: Admin partners list + detail
tasks.goal: Admin partners list (KYC/tax status) + partner detail (sales, upload queue). PII reads audit-logged. Follow admin-partners.md + admin-partner-detail.md.

tasks.title: Admin orders + order detail + refunds queue
tasks.goal: Admin orders list + order detail + refunds approval queue (approve/deny -> triggers refund path). Follow admin-orders.md, admin-order-detail.md, admin-refunds.md.

tasks.title: Admin settings — platform_settings editor (resolves STUB-008/011, DMCA agent)
tasks.goal: Admin settings editor over platform_settings: subscriber discount bps, refund window days, royalty default, DMCA agent contact, support/legal emails. Then wire the READ paths that currently use env: discount engine (STUB-008), 14-day refund window (STUB-011), DMCA agent on /dmca (STUB-009). Remove those STUBS entries. Follow admin-settings.md.

tasks.goal: Admin analytics dashboard, reports surface, and content moderation/review queue. Follow admin-analytics.md, admin-reports.md, admin-review.md.

tasks.title: LMS migration — progress, bookmarks, certificates tables (+RLS)
tasks.goal: New numbered migration adding LMS tables: lesson_progress, bookmarks, certificates (with public verification code). RLS + at least one policy on every new table IN THE SAME migration. Idempotent, runs fresh. Regenerate types if possible. This unblocks PH16 surfaces and resolves STUB-029.

tasks.goal: Lesson progress tracking, bookmarks, and the library-watch progress reading surface. Follow library-watch.md. (Full player is deferred to v1.1 per ADR-0006 — keep that deferral.)

tasks.title: Gorse recommendations — events + rails (fail-open)
tasks.goal: Wire the Gorse seam: emit view/click/add_to_cart/purchase/signup events, and surface recommendation rails on home + product + library. Fail-open: if Gorse is down or unconfigured, the rail simply does not render. Follow ARCHITECTURE.md recommendations section.

tasks.title: Email infrastructure — SES adapter + templates + queue + suppressions
tasks.goal: Amazon SES email infrastructure: env-gated SES adapter (no key = no-op), React Email templates, a send queue, suppression list, and bounce/complaint handling. No triggers yet. Follow ARCHITECTURE.md email section.

tasks.title: Transactional email triggers (resolves STUB-031 etc.)
tasks.goal: Wire transactional emails on order paid, refund, payout, email verify, password reset, and review confirmation (STUB-031). Each trigger uses the SES queue from T25. Update STUBS.md.

tasks.title: Observability — Sentry + log schema + audit-log search UI
tasks.goal: Sentry error reporting (env-gated), a consistent pino log schema, and an audit-log search UI in admin. Optionally move in-process rate limits to a Supabase-backed table (STUB-012/013) if time allows; otherwise leave the STUBs.

tasks.title: Blog index + article (WYSIWYG)

tasks.goal: Site search, the Shopify->Uthena 301 redirect map (part of the data model, not config), and the bundles configurator. Follow the relevant specs; check 01-specs/pages for search/seo/bundles specs and the home/bundles specs.

tasks.title: Ship hardening — full check:all + test + build + STUBS cleanup
tasks.goal: Final hardening: ensure all CI check scripts pass, add/extend unit + e2e tests for the new surfaces, run a production build, do the STUBS.md cleanup pass (renumber duplicate IDs, remove resolved entries), and update the PHASES.md status table + README. This task's gate includes test and build.
